summary: RealVisXL prompt-only outputs repeatedly drifted into naked or scaly generic theropods. They are useful as negative evidence for the pipeline, but must not enter the dromaeosaur_feathered LoRA seed set.
primaryRejectReasons: weak or missing dense feather coverage
sickle-claw cue absent or too weak
some poses drift toward oversized generic theropods
nextRoute: Use guide-first or IP-Adapter/ControlNet expansion from internally authored plumage guides and the current app candidates. Do not use prompt-only RealVisXL generations as training images for this dataset.
